command: LOCK="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/riccon-maven.lock"; while ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 5; done; trap 'rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; rm -rf apps/worker/target/surefire-reports; ./mvnw -q -T1C -pl apps/worker -am test -Dtest='*Injection*Test,*Inj*Test' -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false; code=$?; echo "--- injection surefire summary ---"; grep -h -o "<testsuite[^>]*" apps/worker/target/surefire-reports/TEST-com.riccon.worker.injection.*.xml 2>/dev/null | sed 's/ xmlns[^ ]*//g; s/ version="[^"]*"//'; exit $code
